releases.name: trqsh CLI v0.2.5
releases.body:
## CLI 0.2.5

- Replace cached native binaries older than the npm/PyPI package; preserve
  newer self-updates and honor explicit version pins.
- Detect a Windows global npm command shadowed by another trqsh installation
  and report the conflicting launcher with instructions to switch.
- Restart older CLI daemons when opening an updated console, so login and
  tunnel connections use the new agent. Authenticate before stopping an agent;
  desktop-owned agents are left to their owning app.
- Migrate saved hosted defaults `https://api.trqsh.uz` and `trqsh.uz:4443` to
  `https://tunnel.trqsh.uz` and `wss://tunnel.trqsh.uz/_trqsh/agent`.
  Custom endpoints, explicit overrides, credentials and saved tunnels remain.
- Correct the console's base-domain display for WebSocket server URLs.

```sh
npm install -g @trqsh-uz/trqsh@0.2.5 --foreground-scripts
python -m pip install --upgrade trqsh==0.2.5
```

Choose one package manager for the global `trqsh` command. If switching from
pip to npm, remove the old Python launcher with `python -m pip uninstall trqsh`.
Installing locally with npm does not update a global command.

This package release contains CLI downloads and npm/PyPI wrappers. Public
tunnel URLs still require wildcard DNS/TLS and ingress for `*.tunnel.trqsh.uz`.

releases.name: trqsh CLI v0.2.4
releases.body:
## CLI 0.2.4

- Connect through Cloudflare HTTP tunnels with authenticated WebSocket + yamux
  transport, using normal HTTPS on port 443.
- Default API: `https://tunnel.trqsh.uz`.
- Default agent endpoint: `wss://tunnel.trqsh.uz/_trqsh/agent`.
- Direct QUIC/TCP endpoints remain available through `--server host:port`.
- Download and self-update URLs now use `trqsh-tunnel/trqshcli`; signature
  verification recognizes the new source owner and CLI package release tags.

This release contains native CLI archives, checksums/signature, and npm/PyPI
wrappers. The server must enable `TRQSH_WEBSOCKET_ADDR` behind the HTTPS proxy.
Public tunnel URLs still require wildcard DNS, TLS, and ingress routing for
`*.tunnel.trqsh.uz`; an HTTPS control-plane hostname alone does not configure it.

```sh
npm install -g @trqsh-uz/trqsh@0.2.4
python -m pip install --upgrade trqsh==0.2.4
```

releases.name: trqsh CLI v0.2.2
releases.body:
The CLI now uses `https://trqsh.uz` for its public API and device login by default.

- Keep QR remote sessions alive beyond the REST timeout and register streams before reporting readiness.
- Download npm/PyPI binaries from the canonical `algorithco/trqshcli` release repository.
- Verify checksum signatures from the current tagged release workflow while retaining support for historical signatures from the previous repository owner.

Install or upgrade:

```sh
pip install --upgrade trqsh==0.2.2
```

Archives are available for Windows, macOS and Linux on amd64/arm64, with Debian/RPM packages for Linux. Verify downloads against `checksums.txt` and its Sigstore bundle.

For clients through 0.2.1, upgrade through npm, PyPI or a downloaded archive: their self-updater still expects the previous repository owner's signing identity.

Source: [v0.2.2](https://github.com/algorithco/trqsh/tree/v0.2.2) · [changes](https://github.com/algorithco/trqsh/pull/34).
